question: Of the people who open a subscription paywall, how many select a tier and how many finish or abandon checkout, by surface, tier, and billing interval, per namespace and build? Paywall Opened carries source and current_plan. Upgrade Plan Selected carries plan (tier id), billing_interval, and source. Upgrade Succeeded Attributed carries plan and billing_interval. Subscription Plan Changed carries previous_plan, new_plan, billing_interval, and change_source. The cancel-flow events carry the closed reason enum. Upgrade Succeeded and Upgrade Cancelled stay property-less presence events: the registry forbids adding properties to those released ids, so a completed checkout emits Upgrade Succeeded Attributed in the same call. Upgrade Modal Clicked and Upgrade Modal Dismissed are the app-version update prompt and are not in this funnel. Stripe webhook events, not these client events, are the source of truth for MRR and churn.
zero_policy: Zero events is expected on builds that predate this registration, and on desktop or web until those clients ship the same wire names. A missing Paywall Opened row for one source means that surface did not open the plans sheet in the selected namespace and build.
